description: Took the book, refused a cousin's manners, and claimed six days.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Set the whistle, counted three, and told you to stay away from a play cast without you.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Counted under three hundred, set Monday for the carry, and kept the seven shillings unspent.
name: John Heminges

description: Named nine shillings, old men and country folk, and a house quieter than she is used to.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Missed the first by being early, and came clean on the third.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Brought the leaves in a shirt, having had them since noon yesterday, and gave them up.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Played Egeon, gave the leaves up, and set the fee aside unpaid.
name: William Shakespeare
